verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.browserbase.com, written for agents ("one API key gives your agent everything it needs"). Doc pages are served as raw .md URLs, and Browserbase Skills explicitly teach coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex how to use the platform. Missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents consuming these docs in practice, and evidence of a fuller llms-full.txt-style export.
